overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Will Mbah, a candidate for State Representative in the 34th Middlesex District, regarding his legislative priorities and governing philosophy. Mbah discussed his experience on the Somerville City Council and his proposals for housing reform, government transparency, and senior services.

items.title: Candidate Introduction and Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced Will Mbah, a candidate for State Representative and current Somerville City Councilor, who described his background as an immigrant from Cameroon and his decade of experience in municipal government.

items.title: State Legislative Reform and Transparency
items.summary: Mbah advocated for reforming the state legislature to increase transparency, specifically supporting public access to committee votes, legislative negotiations, and lobbying disclosures.

items.title: Floor Votes and Deliberation
items.summary: Mbah expressed support for open floor votes on legislation, arguing that leadership structures should not serve as a substitute for open deliberation among representatives.

items.title: Affordable Housing Policy
items.summary: Mbah proposed a comprehensive housing strategy that includes increasing supply near transit, strengthening tenant protections, and expanding community land trusts to ensure permanent affordability.

items.title: Leadership Term Limits
items.summary: Mbah stated his support for reasonable term limits on legislative leadership positions and committee chairs to distribute power more broadly across the institution.

items.title: Senior Services and Economic Stability
items.summary: Mbah discussed the need for property tax relief, utility assistance, and accessible public transportation to help senior citizens remain in their communities.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Contact Information
items.summary: Mbah provided his campaign website for voters to review his track record, and Petrella concluded the program with instructions for accessing the show archive and podcast.

subject: Will Mbah State Representative Candidacy
